+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'check agent and start agent: say the result comes as mail, and do not poll'
+---
+## What
+
+`check agent` on a running child gives no sign that its result comes by itself, so the model polls it in a loop. In bench24-1023b, django__django-14999, the root polled `check agent` over and over and got the same answer each time:
+
+```
+Agent diagnose (01M5PD2HHJEYZZCTNHR3XE4NR6) is running.
+Phase: the task turn.
+Passes: 0.
+Last tools: none.
+Text so far: none.
+```
+
+It never stopped to let the result arrive as mail. The user's ask (2026-10-24): "we should have a better message than that and explain that there is no need to loop and check, you can just stop and wait for mail".
+
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun+FinalMessage.swift:42-46` (`runningText`): for a run in operation, give:
+  ```
+  Agent <name> (<id>) is still working.
+  You do not need to check it again. When it finishes, its result comes to you
+  as mail, and you continue from there.
+  Do not wait for it in a loop. Do other work that does not need its result,
+  or stop now: write no text and call no tool. The mail wakes you.
+
+  Progress: <passes> passes; last tools: <tools>; text so far: <tail>.
+  ```
+  Keep the paused sentence and the waiting sentence when they apply.
+- [ ] A second `check agent` of the same run with no progress since the last check (the same passes, tools and text) leads with: "You checked this agent before, and nothing changed."
+- [ ] `start agent`'s result says the same three things, before any check: the result comes as mail, there is no need to check in a loop, and the model can stop now. The text is in `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsToolText.swift`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The `check agent` text of a running run contains "comes to you as mail" and "Do not wait for it in a loop".
+- [ ] A repeated check with no progress leads with "You checked this agent before, and nothing changed."; a check after progress does not.
+- [ ] The `start agent` result of a background run contains "comes to you as mail".
+- [ ] The texts of a settled, cancelled or failed run are unchanged.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/`: the criteria above (find the present tests of `runningText` and of the `start agent` text with `rg -n 'is running' Tests`).
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsAgents: all tests pass, with no new warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then implement until they pass. #no-queue
\ No newline at end of file
